name: Tomato
author: nixfred
description: A pomodoro focus timer for the bar. A ring counts down the current phase; the panel holds presets, today's tomatoes, a 7-day chart, your streak and skip/reset. State is stored as end timestamps in ~/.local/share/tomato, so the timer survives a shell restart.

barWidget.description: Pomodoro ring countdown. Left click starts or pauses, right click opens the panel.

schema.label: Show minutes left
schema.description: Minutes remaining beside the ring. Off leaves just the ring.
